register.labelZh: EYE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: eye somebody up 可以描述教練、僱主、售貨員或其他人仔細觀察某人,判斷對方是否合適。；eye something up 可以描述你感興趣並可能想要的食物、衣服、座位、住所或其他物品。；eye up 通常不只是表示「看見」,還帶有感興趣、正在考慮或仔細評估的意思。
register.summaryEn: Eye somebody up can describe a coach, employer, seller or another person carefully considering whether somebody is suitable. Eye something up can describe looking with interest at food, clothes, seats, homes or other things you may want. Eye up usually expresses more than simply seeing something. It suggests interest, consideration or careful assessment.
contextsZh: 自然表達對某人的觀察或評估
理解某人注視背後的意圖
contextsEn: Talk naturally about assessing or showing interest in people
Talk about things you are interested in choosing
Understand the intention behind somebody’s look

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Decide whether the sentence is about carefully looking at or assessing a person, or showing interest in something that somebody may want. When using him, her, it or them, place the word between eye and up: eye him up eye it up
